data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2017 and prior) increased by $64.2m ($29.5m net of RI). Of this, $58.3m ($26.9m net of RI) relates to Casualty division losses on 2016 and prior underwriting years of account. The remainder is driven by newly occurring large losses, mostly from multi-year construction policies in the Tech division. At the same time claim experience during 2019 on the Aviation and Marine divisions on 2017 and prior underwriting years has been within expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the prior year (opening) was 706.98 (USD millions). During 2019 gross prior-year development was adverse totalling $64.2m (strengthening), driven largely by $58.3m of deterioration in the Casualty division (2016 and prior) and additional large losses primarily from multi-year construction policies in the technical/engineering area. Aviation and Marine prior-year experience was broadly within expectations. The net impact after reinsurance was smaller ($29.5m net).

data.data_quality_notes: All financial statement figures are presented in the report's native currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) 2018 comparative column. Prior year development gross figure ($64.2m) taken verbatim from the narrative (explicit gross amount). Casualty-specific amount $58.3m is explicit. 'Tech division' deterioration described but not quantified separately so mapped to Property for LOB-level prior year events with lower confidence. Claims development triangle is provided (gross) and was used for cross-checks; RITC not apparent. Some mapping of the report's 'Tech' division to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate.
